errors.evidence: The starting value for the Precision line at 'Full model (Ours)' is 65.45, not 65.48.
The description states the Precision line ends at 57.74. However, the purple Precision line ends at 65.44. The value 57.74 is the ending value for the brown F1-score line.
The description inaccurately states that the Precision line is 'decreasing'. The line's value drops at the second point ('w/o Prompt') but then increases for the remaining three points.
The description claims the Recall line starts at 62.63. The blue Recall line actually starts at 65.78. The value 62.63 corresponds to the 'w/o Augmentation' point on the same line.
The description states the F1-score line begins at 64.06. The brown F1-score line actually begins at 65.16. The value 64.06 belongs to the Precision line at the 'w/o Attention' data point.
The description states the F1-score line ends at 56.82. The brown F1-score line actually ends at 57.74. The value 56.82 is the ending value for the blue Recall line.
The description claims there are no markers on the lines, but the plot clearly shows circular markers at every data point for all three lines.
